ns2:course.label: Historical Perspectives on Social Justice
ns2:course.description: Grand Challenge Learning course in the Inequality & Cultural Understanding pathway. Focuses on the historical dimensions of Inequality & Cultural Understanding from an interdisciplinary perspective and emphasizes experiential learning through projects, community-engaged scholarship, video conferences with experts and other collaborative classroom activities. Topics vary by section.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Grand Challenge-Inequality, and Hist&Philosoph Perspect course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is intended for first and second year students.
